title: gaultheria bracteata
intro: Gaultheria bracteata, commonly known as Mountain Tea or Gaultheria, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gaultheria bracteata include its use as an anti-diarrheal, anti-cough, and expectorant, making it beneficial for treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Gaultheria bracteata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
